FN-PVNTGEG-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 189
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Garrett
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 189 as introduced could increase or decrease the obligations of state and local
governments engaging in certain public work contracts by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the difference in any difference in cost from: (1) the current public notice required by law;
and (2) the method of additional methods of public notice allowed, pursuant to the provisions of
this bill, for sealed bid contracts.
